import os, sys, unittest, sqlite3
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import


def make_conn(isolation_level=""):
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=isolation_level)
    initialize(c)
    return c


class ImportContactsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = make_conn()

    def row(self, email="a@b.co", name="Alice"):
        return {"email": email, "name": name}

    def test_inserts_then_updates_and_counts_unchanged_name_as_updated(self):
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, [self.row("x@y.z", "X"), self.row("p@q.r", "P")]),
                         {"inserted": 2, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, [self.row("x@y.z", "X"), self.row("n@m.k", "N")]),
                         {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("n@m.k", "N"), ("p@q.r", "P"), ("x@y.z", "X")])

    def test_trims_and_lowercases_email_and_updates_name(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "bob@example.com", "Old")
        result = import_contacts(self.c, [{"email": "  BOB@Example.COM ", "name": "  Robert  "}])
        self.assertEqual(result, {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("bob@example.com", "Robert")])

    def test_empty_batch_returns_zero_counts(self):
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_invalid_batches_raise_and_leave_contacts_unchanged(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "keep@me.io", "Keep")
        before = list_contacts(self.c)
        bad_batches = [
            [self.row("ok@fine.io"), "not-an-object"],
            [self.row("ok@fine.io"), ["email", "name"]],
            [{"email": "a@b.c"}],
            [{"email": "a@b.c", "name": "A", "extra": 1}],
            [{"email": 5, "name": "A"}],
            [{"email": "a@b.c", "name": None}],
            [self.row("noatsign.io")],
            [self.row("a@b@c.io")],
            [self.row("@b.io")],
            [self.row("a@")],
            [self.row("a b@c.io")],
            [self.row("a\t@c.io")],
            [self.row("ok@fine.io", "   ")],
            [self.row("ok@fine.io"), self.row("OK@fine.io ", "Again")],
            [self.row("keep@me.io", "Changed"), self.row("bad", "X")],
        ]
        for batch in bad_batches:
            with self.subTest(batch=batch):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(self.c, batch)
                self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), before)

    def test_rejects_non_list_rows(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_contacts(self.c, None)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_contacts(self.c, self.row())

    def test_database_failure_mid_batch_rolls_back_everything(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "old@one.io", "Old")
        self.c.execute(
            "CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.name = 'BOOM' "
            "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
        self.c.commit()
        before = list_contacts(self.c)
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.Error):
            import_contacts(self.c, [self.row("old@one.io", "Changed"),
                                     self.row("new@two.io", "New"),
                                     self.row("bad@three.io", "BOOM")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), before)
        self.assertFalse(self.c.in_transaction)

    def test_atomic_on_autocommit_connection(self):
        c = make_conn(isolation_level=None)
        add_contact(c, "old@one.io", "Old")
        c.execute(
            "CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.name = 'BOOM' "
            "BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
        before = list_contacts(c)
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.Error):
            import_contacts(c, [self.row("old@one.io", "Changed"), self.row("new@two.io", "BOOM")])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(c), before)
        self.assertFalse(c.in_transaction)
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(c, [self.row("new@two.io", "Fine")]),
                         {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})

    def test_large_batch_counts_correctly(self):
        add_contact(self.c, "u0@x.io", "U")
        rows = [self.row("u%d@x.io" % i, "N%d" % i) for i in range(1200)]
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.c, rows), {"inserted": 1199, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(len(list_contacts(self.c)), 1200)


class HandleImportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c = make_conn()

    def test_valid_envelope_returns_summary(self):
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [{"email": "A@b.io", "name": "A"}]}),
                         {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0})
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": []}), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})

    def test_malformed_envelopes_raise_value_error(self):
        for payload in [None, [], "x", {}, {"rows": []}, {"contacts": [], "extra": 1},
                        {"contacts": {"email": "a@b.io", "name": "A"}}, {"contacts": None}]:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    handle_import(self.c, payload)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [])

    def test_invalid_row_through_api_leaves_contacts_unchanged(self):
        handle_add(self.c, {"email": "a@b.io", "name": "A"})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            handle_import(self.c, {"contacts": [{"email": "z@z.io", "name": "Z"}, {"email": "a@b.io"}]})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b.io", "A")])

    def test_existing_add_contact_and_list_still_work(self):
        self.assertEqual(handle_add(self.c, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"}), {"ok": True})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.c), [("a@b", "Alice")])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
